name: Speak with Deino
summary: In Orgrimmar, Deino calls promising Horde mages to aid their craft. The troll mage works from the Valley of Spirits and seeks an adept for important work. Her summons opens a path to deeper study and duties across Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Summons to Orgrimmar
sections.body: Horde mages hone their arcane abilities under the guidance of instructors. When a student is ready for harder work, mentors such as Anastasia Hartwell in the Undercity point the way to Orgrimmar. In its troll quarter, specialized knowledge and dangerous work await.

sections.title: The Valley of Spirits and Darkbriar Lodge
sections.body: Deino lives in Darkbriar Lodge in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits. Among the Darkspear, few study arcane magic compared with the many witch doctors and priests, which makes Deino an authority in the capital. Her work serves Horde mages beyond local concerns, and she seeks ambitious spellcasters willing to face dangers far from home.

faq.q: Who sends you to speak with Deino?
aliases: where do i get speak with deino
faq.answer: Mage trainers such as Anastasia Hartwell in Undercity's Magic Quarter send aspiring mages to Orgrimmar when their skill is sufficient.
You can find Deino inside Darkbriar Lodge, in the Valley of Spirits on Orgrimmar's western side.
Deino oversees research and work important to Horde mages. She sends capable spellcasters into dangerous lands to find rare magical resources.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Deino?
faq.answer: When you report to Deino, she explains her work and sends you to gather the Waters of Xavian.

faq.q: Is this quest available to all classes?
faq.answer: No. Only Horde mages receive Deino's summons as part of their class training.

faq.q: Are troll mages common in the Horde?
faq.answer: Arcane magic is less common among Darkspear trolls than shamanism, voodoo, or service to the loa. Deino shows that some trolls have mastered the formal study of arcane forces.

angles.text: As a mage, you deepen your arcane training and meet senior spellcasters in Orgrimmar.
As a troll, you see the focused arcane discipline practiced by a select few among the Darkspear.
As a member of the Horde, you follow a summons linking trainers in Lordaeron and Durotar with Orgrimmar's arcane leaders.
